coverage: Klang Valley: Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya and the Selangor districts around them
inclusion: A place is listed when at least one dermatologist in the Persatuan Dermatologi Malaysia directory names it as where they practise. Aesthetic clinics without a dermatologist are not listed.

sources.dermatologists: Persatuan Dermatologi Malaysia, Directory of Dermatologists (dermatology.org.my), read 2026-11-17
sources.locations: Map data from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), looked up with Nominatim on 2026-11-17

excluded.Nilai Medical Centre: in Negeri Sembilan, outside the Klang Valley (listed by dr-Wee-Ai-Leen)
excluded.UiTM Faculty of Medicine, Selayang campu: academic faculty address, not a patient clinic (dr-tarita-taib)
excluded.Clinic at 11 Jalan 19/29, Petaling Jaya: no clinic name, and no current source could confirm it is open (dr-tan-seng-giaw)
excluded.Hospital Shah Alam: no dermatology service found on its own pages (checked 2026-11-17)
excluded.Aesthetic clinics in Sunway, Subang, USJ: run by general or aesthetic doctors, not dermatologists (Erufu Care listings, 2026-11-17)
